reviews.title: Not inclusive
reviews.text: You need either Spotify or Apple Music for it to work

reviews.title: Doesn’t work with Apple Music
reviews.text:
Doesn’t work with latest version of iOS, App seems halfway abandoned.

I have Apple Music with a subscription but the app won’t start when I tap Apple Music. Only complains it needs a subscription.

Still broken after months. App is basically abandoned.

reviews.title: Locked in
reviews.text: You cannot listen to maxs sleep unless you subscribe to Spotify or Apple Music. I find this very wrong. What happened to owning your music collection?
